title: Ashbury Rewards Member Tenure Recognition: Tenure Discount on Points Purchases
content:
**T1 — Discount.** Long-standing Ashbury Rewards members pay less per thousand points when they buy points. The tenure discount is seventy-five cents per thousand points for a member enrolled for at least one hundred and twenty whole calendar months by the handling date, twenty-five cents for a member enrolled for thirty-six to one hundred and nineteen whole months, and nothing for a member enrolled for fewer months.

**T2 — Effect.** The tenure discount reduces the price per thousand points of a points purchase.

**T3 — Months.** The months are whole calendar months from the enrolment date on the membership to the handling date.

| Whole calendar months enrolled by the handling date | Tenure discount per 1000 points |
|---|---|
| Fewer than 36 | None |
| 36 to 119 | 0.25 USD |
| 120 or more | 0.75 USD |

**Boundary dates under T3 (hypothetical handling date of 5 February 2027).** An enrolment on 6 February 2024 gives 35 whole months and no discount; on 5 February 2024, 36 months and 0.25 USD. An enrolment on 6 February 2017 gives 119 months and 0.25 USD; on 5 February 2017, 120 months and 0.75 USD.
